KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

3. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. kitoto
   D. mato

4. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

6. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

7. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.

8. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

9. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.

10. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. zito

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain miezi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

3. B — watoto

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

5. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

6. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

8. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

9. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

10. B — fupi
